t: 贾德维加被加冕为波兰国王,尽管她是女性.
te: Jadwiga is crowned King of Poland, although she is a woman.
dz: 贾德维加被加冕为波兰国王,尽管她是女性.
de: Jadwiga is crowned King of Poland, although she is a woman.

t: 教宗乌尔班五世入罗马,是自阿维尼翁教宗开始后50多年间第一个入罗马的教宗.
te: Pope Urban V enters Rome, the first pope to do so in more than fifty years since the beginning of the Avignon Papacy.
dz: 教宗乌尔班五世入罗马,是自阿维尼翁教宗开始后50多年间第一个入罗马的教宗.
de: Pope Urban V enters Rome, the first pope to do so in more than fifty years since the beginning of the Avignon Papacy.

t: 维埃纳议会首次召开。
te: The Council of Vienne convenes for the first time.
dz: 维埃纳议会首次召开。
de: The Council of Vienne convenes for the first time.

t: 奥托一世国王在现在的梅克伦堡-沃波默恩击败了一场斯拉夫人起义.
te: King Otto I defeats a Slavic revolt in what is now Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
dz: 奥托一世国王在现在的梅克伦堡-沃波默恩击败了一场斯拉夫人起义.
de: King Otto I defeats a Slavic revolt in what is now Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

t: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世成为科尔多瓦第八任埃米尔。
te: Abd ar-Rahman III becomes the eighth Emir of Córdoba.
dz: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世成为科尔多瓦第八任埃米尔。
de: Abd ar-Rahman III becomes the eighth Emir of Córdoba.

t: 后吴泽甸登上唐朝王位并宣布自己为中华帝国的统治者.
te: Empress Wu Zetian ascends to the throne of the Tang dynasty and proclaims herself ruler of the Chinese Empire.
dz: 后吴泽甸登上唐朝王位并宣布自己为中华帝国的统治者.
de: Empress Wu Zetian ascends to the throne of the Tang dynasty and proclaims herself ruler of the Chinese Empire.

t: 里西默在皮亚琴察击败了阿维图斯并成为了西罗马帝国的主人.
te: Ricimer defeats Avitus at Piacenza and becomes master of the Western Roman Empire.
dz: 里西默在皮亚琴察击败了阿维图斯并成为了西罗马帝国的主人.
de: Ricimer defeats Avitus at Piacenza and becomes master of the Western Roman Empire.
